INBOX_SUB:
Inbox: {path}

ROLLBACK_CONFIRM_FD:
Roll back transaction {txn}?
This restores the mod folder from quarantine (file_drop: no ModsConfig.xml snapshot).
ROLLBACK_CONFIRM_XML:
Roll back transaction {txn}?
This restores the previous ModsConfig.xml from the journal snapshot (and the mod folder from quarantine).

MODLIST_SUB: Parsed from each mod's manifest. Missing dependencies / duplicate IDs are highlighted. When writes are allowed, opening an entry offers Uninstall (moved to quarantine, never deleted).
MODLIST_OUTDATED_DEPS: Dependencies below required version: {v} (download a newer copy, then import it here)
MODLIST_BTN_DESC: Read-only list of installed mods, dependencies and duplicate IDs.
CONFIRM_INSTALL_FD: Install {name} ({uid}) to {target}? (file_drop: unpacking the directory IS the enable step)
CONFIRM_UNINSTALL: Uninstall {pid}? The folder is moved to quarantine (not deleted).
CONFIRM_UNINSTALL_WITH_DEPENDENTS: Uninstall {pid}? {n} installed mod(s) need it and will stop loading: {who}. The folder is moved to quarantine (not deleted).
CONFIRM_DISABLE_WITH_DEPENDENTS: Disable {pid}? {n} installed mod(s) need it and will stop loading: {who}. The folder is moved to the disabled folder (not deleted).
LIMIT_DETECT_ONLY: DETECT-ONLY: depends on the user's ALREADY-CONFIGURED SMAPI install and Steam launch options. If SMAPI is missing or launch options are not set, the plugin reports an error; it does NOT install SMAPI or edit launch options.
LIMIT_COEXISTENCE: COEXISTENCE: if Mods/.mm_deployed or a sibling Mods_Core/ is detected (Amethyst ModManager VFS deployment), the plugin switches to READ-ONLY mode and refuses every write with E_EXTERNAL_MANAGER. It never touches symlinks or Mods_Core/.
LIMIT_FILEDROP_NO_ORDER: file_drop has no load-order or dependency solving. SMAPI itself resolves dependencies at runtime. Out of MVP.
LIMIT_NO_UNIVERSAL: No universal one-click install, no Workshop, no loaders install, no Proton prefix access, no .exe installers, no root, no SteamOS read-only toggle.
LIMIT_GH_COVERAGE: GITHUB COVERAGE: popular mods are often published only on other sites with no GitHub Release, so search will not find a downloadable ZIP. Use the direct HTTPS URL instead.
LIMIT_DIRECT_URL: DIRECT URL: no repository-level trust anchor, so any HTTPS ZIP can be downloaded; whether it is acceptable is decided only by the manifest inside, so read the inspect step carefully.
LIMIT_ORDER_APPEND: insert_mode=append_to_end + load_order_solver=false + dependency_solver=false: ordering-sensitive mods appended at the END may not work. Reordering must be done in-game by the user (out of MVP).
LIMIT_NO_AUTO_RESOLVE: No automatic conflict/dependency resolution, no network/Workshop, no loaders, no load-order editing, no Proton prefix access, no .exe installers.
ERR_E_BACKEND_UNREACHABLE: Backend is not reachable. Reopen the plugin or restart the Steam Deck.
ERR_E_BRIDGE: Communication with the plugin backend failed.
ERR_E_UNKNOWN: An unexpected error occurred. See the log for details.
ERR_E_GAME_NOT_FOUND: The configured game was not found in any Steam library.
ERR_E_GAME_AMBIGUOUS: The configured game was found in more than one Steam library; cannot choose automatically.
ERR_E_CAPABILITY_DISABLED: This action is not available in this version.
ERR_E_MOD_NOT_FOUND: No installed mod matches this name. Refresh the list; it may have been removed already.
ERR_E_GAME_RUNNING: The game is running. Close it before changing mods.
ERR_E_FLATPAK_PERMISSION: Flatpak Steam uses an isolated library path. This build does not manage it.
ERR_E_LOADER_REQUIRED: This sample game does not need a loader. (Reserved for planned games.)
ERR_E_PROTON_PREFIX_MISSING: This sample game does not need a Proton prefix. (Reserved for planned games.)
ERR_E_LOADER_MISSING: SMAPI was not detected. This plugin does NOT install SMAPI; install it yourself or fix the launch options.
ERR_E_LAUNCH_OPTIONS_MISSING: The Steam launch options do not point at SMAPI. This plugin does NOT edit launch options.
ERR_E_EXTERNAL_MANAGER: Another mod manager owns this Mods folder (symlink deployment detected). Read-only mode: install/enable/uninstall/rollback are refused to avoid damaging it.
ERR_E_MANIFEST_UNSAFE: The SMAPI manifest.json is missing required fields or has an invalid UniqueID.
ERR_E_INBOX_MISSING: The import folder does not exist.
ERR_E_INBOX_EMPTY: No ZIP files found in the import folder.
ERR_E_INBOX_UNREADABLE: A file in the import folder could not be read.
ERR_E_PATH_INVALID: The given path is not allowed.
ERR_E_PATH_ESCAPE: The path points outside an allowed folder.
ERR_E_NOT_ALLOWED_ROOT: The target is outside the allowed write locations.
ERR_E_BAD_ARCHIVE: The file is not a valid ZIP archive.
ERR_E_ZIP_BOMB: The archive is too large or too highly compressed to import safely.
ERR_E_ZIP_SLIP: The archive contains a path that escapes the mod folder.
ERR_E_UNSAFE_ENTRY: The archive contains an unsafe entry (link, device, or forbidden file type).
ERR_E_DUPLICATE_ENTRY: The archive contains duplicate file names.
ERR_E_MANIFEST_MISSING: About/About.xml was not found in the archive.
ERR_E_MULTI_MOD_ARCHIVE: This archive holds several mods; import them one at a time.
ERR_E_ID_INVALID: The mod's packageId is missing or invalid.
ERR_E_FIELD_MISSING: A required field is missing from About.xml.
ERR_E_DUPLICATE: This mod (same packageId) is already installed. Use Replace instead.
ERR_E_FILE_COLLISION: A folder with this name already exists and is not managed by this plugin.
ERR_E_ACCESS: Permission denied while writing. The location may be read-only.
ERR_E_READONLY_FS: The target filesystem is read-only; no files were changed.
ERR_E_NO_SPACE: Not enough free space to complete the operation.
ERR_E_CROSS_DEVICE: The staging and target are on different filesystems; operation refused.
ERR_E_FS_NO_POSIX: This drive (e.g. microSD/exFAT) has no POSIX permissions; ownership checks were skipped.
ERR_E_ROOT_OWNED: A target file is owned by another user; refusing to change its permissions.
ERR_E_STATE_OWNED: The game state file is owned by another user; refusing to edit it.
ERR_E_STATE_SYMLINK: The game state file is a symbolic link; refusing to edit it.
ERR_E_STAGING_IN_MODS: Staging/quarantine must not be placed inside the Mods folder.
ERR_E_INODE_MISMATCH: Files changed between the safety check and the write; operation aborted.
ERR_E_CORE_MISSING: Core (ludeon.rimworld) is missing or not first in ModsConfig.xml; refusing to edit.
ERR_E_STATE_CORRUPT: ModsConfig.xml could not be parsed; refusing to edit it.
ERR_E_STATE_EXTERNAL: ModsConfig.xml was changed outside this plugin (or by the game on quit). Refresh and retry.
ERR_E_STATE_MISSING: ModsConfig.xml was not found at the expected location.
ERR_E_VERIFY_FAILED: The post-write verification did not match what was planned.
ERR_E_OP_FAILED: The operation failed and was rolled back where possible.
ERR_E_RECOVERY_PENDING: A previous operation did not finish. Use Recover / Rollback first.
ERR_E_ROLLBACK_FAILED: Automatic rollback could not finish. Your data is preserved in the quarantine folder; see the log.
ERR_E_QUARANTINE_FULL: The quarantine folder is full; uninstall was refused.

LIB_IDENTIFY_ONLY: Recognition only — this game has no writable adapter; nothing is installed or changed.

DEPS_BTN_SUB: One tap: install or open download page
DEPS_BTN_DESC: Checks the required mods this game is missing. Anything the plugin can download is installed; the rest opens its Nexus page so you can download it in the browser.
DEPS_INSTALL_SUB: Fetches only the mods whose manifest matches

NEXUS_SECTION_DESC: Everything here opens the real Nexus page in your signed-in browser. Download the mod there, come back to this panel — new downloads install automatically. No API key needed.
NEXUS_RECENT_DESC: Open the website's live listing — Trending, Newest, or Updated. No API key needed; your signed-in browser shows real results.
NEXUS_MOD_FETCH_DESC: Open this mod's Nexus page in the browser. Download there, then come back — it installs automatically.
NEXUS_BAD_ID: That is not a whole number.
LOADER_LOG_LINE: Last launch: {loaded} mods, {packs} content packs, {skipped} skipped
LOADER_LOG_NONE: The game has not been launched since this plugin was installed, so there is no loader log yet.
LOADER_LOG_TRUNCATED: The log was larger than the 4 MB cap; only the beginning was read.
OPEN_PAGE_WHY: This hands the address to the Steam client, which is the browser you can actually see in Game Mode. If nothing appears, the client refused the request -- copy the URL below instead.
OPEN_PAGE_FREE: A free Nexus account cannot get a download link from the API, so use this page: download there, then import the ZIP back here.
SEARCH_SECTION_DESC: The Nexus API has no search endpoint, so this opens the site's own search page with your keyword — that is the only place real results exist.
SEARCH_INPUT_DESC: e.g. automate, chests, HD textures. Up to 64 characters; quotes and punctuation are fine.
SEARCH_BTN_DESC: Opens the browser you can actually see in Game Mode.
SEARCH_FAIL: The search page did not open.
SEARCH_WHY: This hands the address to the Steam client, which is the browser visible in Game Mode. If nothing appeared, copy the address below into a browser.
SEARCH_DOWNLOAD_NOTE: Download the file in that browser, then come back to the import list — it now reads your Downloads folder too.

CP_LIMIT_FRAMEWORKS: Frameworks (CET, RED4ext, ArchiveXL, redscript) must be installed by you; this plugin only drops their files.
CP_LIMIT_LOADORDER: No load order: Cyberpunk resolves archives by name, so two mods editing the same record still conflict.
CP_LIMIT_REDMOD_COMPILE: REDmod packages are detected but not compiled; run redmod yourself if a mod ships uncompiled scripts.
GS_SUB: Where does this game load mods from? The plugin only writes inside the folder you pick, and this does not install any loader.
GS_WILL_CREATE: will be created — only if you already installed the loader
GS_FAIL: Could not read this game's folders.
GS_REFUSED_BODY: {name} is an online game with anti-cheat. Modding it risks a ban, so this plugin will not touch it.
GS_LOADER_HEAD_SUB: Open the official page, download the ZIP, then install it — journaled and removable like any mod. Steam launch options are never edited.
GS_LOADER_INSTALL_SUB: Pick the ZIP you just downloaded; the plugin extracts it into the game folder.
GS_LOADER_PICK_SUB: These are the ZIPs in your download folders. A = extract into the game folder.
GS_LOADER_REMOVABLE: Removable afterwards: uninstall it from the mods list like any mod.
GS_LOADER_OPENED: {name} download page opened — grab the ZIP, then come back.
GS_LOADER_DONE: {n} files installed as {pid}. Remove it from the mods list any time.

GAME_MGMT_SETUP_SUB: Re-pick where this game's loader reads mods from, or remove the configuration.
GAME_MGMT_SUB: This game can be managed by the plugin.
GAME_MGMT_BUILTIN_SUB: Built-in adaptation: the mod folders are fixed by the descriptor — no manual setup needed.
USER_LIMIT_LOADER: This plugin does not install the mod loader (BepInEx/MelonLoader/UE4SS). Without one, files in the folder may not be loaded by the game.
USER_LIMIT_LAUNCHOPTS: This plugin never edits Steam launch options. If the loader needs one (e.g. WINEDLLOVERRIDES for BepInEx on Proton), the panel shows the text and you paste it into Steam yourself.
USER_LIMIT_ORDER: No load order: two mods shipping the same path keep whichever was installed last.
